annotations.title: Buy a data product with credits

description: Buy a product with your credits; most products ship their data inline in the response. Deliverability is product-specific, including grade availability; check /v1/credits/pricing before buying — call list_products for the live prices rather than trusting a figure restated here, which is how a price in a second place drifts from the first. The signal_* keys (retired, not sold), dag_pro (sold as dag_manifold_30d), dag_quant, dag_enterprise and mcp_unlimited (not on sale yet) return 503 not_yet_deliverable and charge nothing; they are deliberately blocked, not broken. Most products deliver data inline; dag_manifold_30d delivers a 30-day DAG manifold API key inline; a delivery larger than 4 MB (today depin_history and lead_lag_correlations, each tens of MB, and derivation_replay whenever its 100 raw upstream bodies pass 4 MB, as an unfiltered pull does today) returns the receipt and a no-charge URL that serves the stored payload. Every purchase carries an idempotency_key (yours, or one generated and returned to you): if a call errors, the answer says whether you may have been charged, and repeating it with the same idempotency_key returns the receipt and data without a second charge. Use api_key from register_agent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any stable string unique to THIS intended purchase (e.g. a uuid); when absent the server generates one and returns it on any error it can still answer. Send your own: if your connection is cut before any answer arrives (a client or proxy timeout; the public endpoint gives up on a request that has not answered within about 60 s), only a key you chose lets you replay. If a network error makes you retry the same call, re-send the SAME idempotency_key: the retry returns the same receipt and re-delivers the data without a second charge.

product_key.description: Product key to purchase (e.g. depin_provenance, depin_networks; list_products has every key and price)
